notes.title: 🛠️ Demo Update: Under Construction
notes.notes:
Hey Pilots! ✈️

We wanted to let you know that we’ll be taking the demo for Lou’s Lagoon offline later today for a while. Why? Because it’s time to put it under construction! 🛠️

You gave us a lot of feedback—what you loved, what needed a bit more polish, and everything in between—and we’ve been listening! Based on your feedback, we’re hard at work improving both Lou’s Lagoon as a whole as well as the demo.

Thank you so much for playing, sharing your thoughts, and being part of this journey with us. We’ll let you know when our demo is back up and better than ever before! 🥰

Stay tuned for updates! ✈️✨

[i]- The Tiny Roar Team[/i]

notes.title: Demo Patch: Analytics Fixes
notes.notes: A very small update introducing some analytics fixes. This should not otherwise impact the demo.

notes.title: Demo Update: Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hi Pilots!

We hope you’re enjoying the demo! We’re excited to share more details about the work that went into it in a Devlog very soon. In the meantime, we’re making the following changes and fixes later today:

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Jackie has closed-up shop for the time being to restock.
[*] Made some tweaks to the quest flow
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed main menu UI disappearing when pressing Esc/Select
[*] Fixed duplicate music during demo end trailer
[*] Fixed UI focus being stuck in settings when resuming gameplay
[*] Fixed some placement & wording of button input prompts
[/list]
That’s all for now! If you haven’t already played the demo, we’d love to see you on the island. There’s also time to enter our giveaway to win a copy of the game via [url=https://discord.gg/VfUWkQ8XX6]Discord[/url] or [url=https://bsky.app/profile/tinyroargames.bsky.social/post/3li5ijibpdk2q]Bluesky[/url].

[i]The Lou’s Lagoon Team[/i]
